objective: Expose a read-only issue tracker query through an existing external API.

dependencies: Existing HTTP adapter and credential-reference boundary.
permissions: Exact issue.read grant for one repository.
data_model: Immutable tool definition and content-minimized call receipt.
failure_modes: Reject missing grants, unavailable credentials, invalid responses, and timeouts.
tests: Validate schema, authorization, redaction, timeout, and response bounds.
benchmark: Compare baseline manual lookup with candidate quality, latency, tokens, and security.
telemetry: Record tool identity, status, latency, and token-free result size.
security: Keep credentials opaque and frame all remote content as untrusted.
rollout_strategy: Register quarantined, validate locally, then require explicit activation.
